title: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
abstract: arXiv:2611.34049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are positioned to act as orbital edge-compute nodes in emerging 6G non-terrestrial networks, supporting forecasting and control tasks for ground cellular infrastructure. However, training such models is challenged by heterogeneous ground-cell traffic patterns, intermittent links to ground stations, and the satellites' own orbital motion, which continuously shifts the data each satellite observes. In this work, we extend Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to the LEO setting and apply it to cellular internet-traffic forecasting on the Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino dataset. translated_title: 面向低轨星座蜂窝流量预测的去中心化聚类联邦学习
translated_abstract: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座有望在新兴的6G非地面网络中充当轨道边缘计算节点，为地面蜂窝基础设施的预测与控制任务提供支持。然而，训练此类模型面临多重挑战：地面小区流量模式的异构性、与地面站之间链路的间歇性，以及卫星自身的轨道运动——它会持续改变每颗卫星所观测到的数据。在本工作中，我们将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到LEO场景，并将其应用于Telecom Italia米兰+特伦托数据集上的蜂窝互联网流量预测。卫星之间仅通过k近邻的星间gossip通信进行协作，无需地面侧聚合器；同时，零样本头选择机制使每颗卫星能够专门适配其正下方地面小区的潜在流量模式。在训练后K=20个轨道快照上的平均结果显示，我们的扩展方法降低了（预测误差）……
tldr: 该论文将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到低轨卫星星座场景，通过k近邻星间gossip协作与零样本头选择机制，在无地面聚合器的条件下让每颗卫星自适应地预测其下方地面小区的蜂窝流量，显著降低预测误差。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to LEO constellations, enabling satellites to forecast cellular traffic for the ground cells beneath them via k-nearest inter-satellite gossip and zero-shot head selection, without any ground-side aggregator.
